data.name: Usage
data.value:
washi {0} - open-source PDF toolkit (pre-alpha)
usage: washi --version washi masume detect <in.pdf> [-o out] suggest form fields -> fields.json + overlay PNGs washi masume eval <in.pdf> [-o out] score detection against the PDF's existing fields washi form make <in.pdf> [-o out.pdf] [--fields fields.json] [--lang auto|ja|zh-Hans|zh-Hant|ko|en|fr|de] make a fillable PDF (fields are detected unless --fields is given) --embed-font <font.ttf|.otf|.ttc> [--font-index n]: embed a whole font so rare characters show in every viewer (adds the font size to the file)
The interface follows your system language. Set WASHI_LANG (e.g. ja, ko, fr) to change it.

data.name: PrefilledNote
data.value: {0} fields already contain printed data (red dashed outline in the overlay)

data.name: EvalRecall
data.value: recall {0}/{1} = {2:P0} (real fields covered by a detection)

data.name: EvalPrecision
data.value: precision {0}/{1} = {2:P0} (detections that sit on a real field)

data.name: LangFromSystem
data.value: from your system language (the page text was unreadable)

data.name: PagesStraightened
data.value: {0} rotated page(s) straightened so the fields stay upright

data.name: ProtectedPdf
data.value: {0} is protected against changes (it needs the owner password). Washi does not remove protection: ask the author for an unprotected copy.

data.name: FontEmbedded
data.value: embedded font {0} ({1} MB): every viewer can show all of its characters

data.name: FontNotAllowed
data.value: The licence of {0} does not allow embedding it in a PDF people can edit (OS/2 fsType {1}). Choose another font.

data.name: FontNotSupported
data.value: {0} cannot be embedded: variable fonts and files that are not TrueType/OpenType fonts are not supported. Use a static .ttf, .otf or .ttc.

data.name: UnknownLanguage
data.value: Unknown form language '{0}'. Use one of: auto, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ko, en, fr, de

data.name: Ui_NoSelection
data.value: Select a field on the page or in the list.

data.name: Ui_Hint
data.value: Drag a field to move it, its corner to resize it. Delete removes it, arrow keys nudge it.

data.name: Ui_DrawHint
data.value: Drag on the page to draw a new field.

data.name: UsageAi
data.value: AI (Claude by default; data is shown and confirmed before it is sent): washi ai config [anthropic|openai|deepseek|local <model> [--endpoint url] [--vision yes|no]] washi ai key <anthropic|openai|deepseek> store an API key in the macOS Keychain washi ai models list the models the provider offers washi ai name-fields <in.pdf> [--fields f.json] [-o out.json] [--yes] washi ai fill <fillable.pdf> --profile me.txt [-o out.pdf] [--embed-font f] [--yes] washi ai ask <in.pdf> "question" [--yes]

data.name: Ai_KeyPrompt
data.value: Paste the {0} API key (it is not shown):

data.name: Ai_KeyStored
data.value: Stored in the macOS Keychain (service "washi", account "{0}").

data.name: Ai_Local
data.value: Local model {0}: nothing leaves this computer.

data.name: Ai_NeedYes
data.value: Nothing was sent: add --yes to confirm when there is no terminal to ask.

data.name: Ai_NoProfile
data.value: --profile <file> is required: a text or JSON file with the data to fill in.
